lines.text: Many learners say: I suggest to go to the park.
Better: I suggest going to the park.
After suggest, say going, not to go.
The second! He suggests leaving early.

data.wrong: I suggest to go to the park.
data.right: I suggest going to the park.
data.why: After suggest, say going, not to go.

native.tip: نقول «أقترح أن نذهب»، أما بعد suggest فنستخدم الفعل مع ing: “I suggest going to the park.” وليس “I suggest to go to the park.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I suggest to go to the park.” 😅 نقول «أقترح أن نذهب»، أما بعد suggest فنستخدم الفعل مع ing، فالجملة الصحيحة “I suggest going to the park.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “suggest going” — نقول «أقترح أن نذهب»، أما بعد suggest فنستخدم الفعل مع ing. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «أقترح أن نذهب» with «أن», but after suggest we use the verb with ing: “I suggest going to the park.” not “I suggest to go to the park.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I suggest to go to the park.” 😅 In Arabic we say «أقترح أن نذهب» with «أن», but after suggest we use the verb with ing, so the right sentence is “I suggest going to the park.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
